verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a device agent, an MDM integration, or per-employee workstation checks such as disk encryption, screen lock, or password manager. Generic integration claims, personnel custom fields, and the custom-resource API are adjacent or developer building blocks, not this capability. The axis clearly applies to a compliance automation platform, so the absence of evidence yields none.
